notes: cooperative/envoy: Transferable credit lets cooperative pay commons with guild's debt of 3, freeing withheld services in both directions. Work is stalling at the limit; passing claims on clears it without anyone giving more than they owe.

commons/envoy: Proposing transferable credit changes nothing; it is already in force. Debts run one way, guild to cooperative to commons, so no cycle clears. Provision would serve need: commons has 5 tasks left and only gift or provision would reach them.

guild/envoy: Guild is at its limit with cooperative while work sits undone. Commons holds most of the open work; would anyone back cleared credit or provision so service isn't withheld at the limit? I'd support it.

cooperative/envoy: Transferable credit is already in force, so p1 changes nothing. Our debts form a chain: guild owes us 3, we owe commons 3. I'd consider cleared credit or provision so withheld work can flow again.
